statement.zh: 将陶寺简单等同于文献「尧都」或夏早期王都，仍属可争议的历史—考古对接模型，不是本库定论。
statement.en: Equating Taosi simply with textual ‘Yao’s capital’ or an early Xia royal seat remains a contested historical–archaeological mapping, not library fact.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / scholarly model — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.
